A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CARE research. Their text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, latency measurements, multiple-context experiments and qualitative cases in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 2–4 and 7–8 and the case studies in Table 11.

M1.justification: CARE retains the same context assessor, frozen base LLM, reconstruction pre-training, grounded/adversarial soft prompting and combined language-modeling/distillation objective. Equations 1–10 and the backbone-specific adapter configurations are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use Wikipedia, Natural Questions, TriviaQA, WebQA, TruthfulQA and FactKG with the same task coverage. The multiple-context evaluation already appears in v1 Appendix E and moves to v2 Appendix C.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the main benchmarks, Qwen evaluation, latency comparison and embedding visualization. RetRobust, Direct FT, CAD, ADACAD, Adaptive-RAG, SKR-kNN, Priori Judgment and the relevant reference baselines are retained.

E3.justification: Appendix A.1 revises the stated batch size from 32 with accumulation factor 2 to 64 with an unspecified accumulation count. This changes the reported setting, but does not establish a different effective batch size or rerun experiments. Splits, metrics and testing procedures are retained.

E4.justification: The component and loss ablations, Resilience/Boost analysis, t-SNE comparison, multiple-context study and qualitative cases are retained. Reorganizing the appendices adds no new robustness tests or supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: v2 Appendix A.1 newly states that all experiments use a single seed; v1 provides no seed-count statement. This is additional disclosure, not evidence of reduced runs. Neither version reports confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Benchmark scores, ablation results, inference latencies, plotted findings and case outputs are unchanged. CARE's Table 2 averages remain 0.458 for Mistral and 0.467 for LLaMA; its Qwen average remains 0.454 in Table 7.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and losses in Equations 1–10 are unchanged. Neither version introduces additional theorems, proofs or formal assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about resolving context-memory conflict, preserving the frozen LLM's general capabilities and improving QA/fact-checking performance. Describing confidence as implicit clarifies the existing contribution.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability qualifications are retained. Section 7 still discusses the top-1/single-step focus, fixed memory-token capacity and limitations of using closed-book correctness to estimate parametric knowledge.

D1.justification: v2 adds a CARE repository link instead of promising release upon acceptance. Appendix A.1 and Table 10 specify one pre-training epoch, two fine-tuning epochs for Mistral/LLaMA and four for Qwen, plus approximately 25-hour pre-training and 3-hour fine-tuning for LLaMA. The previously explicit accumulation factor is omitted.

R1.justification: The bibliography is unchanged. Sections 1–2 revise the description of decoding intervention from after to during generation and sharpen CARE's representation-level positioning relative to retrieval-stage and decoding-stage approaches.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized language revisions in the introduction, related work and implementation descriptions, and adds acknowledgments. Prompt examples and baseline implementation details become Appendices A.2–A.3, with subsequent appendices renumbered; the main narrative structure remains intact.

P2.justification: The five figure graphics are unchanged, with a small Figure 4 caption revision. The hyperparameter table reorders model columns and adds epoch rows. Dataset statistics and case-study tables are relocated and renumbered, producing limited layout changes.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves transparency and reproducibility through its repository link, explicit training schedules and durations, and single-seed disclosure. Exposition and appendix organization also improve slightly. The scientific evidence remains unchanged, and omission of the accumulation factor leaves some batching ambiguity, limiting the overall gain.
